tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Income Tax Department has issued notice of demand under section 156 of the Income Tax Act, pursuant to computation made under section 154 of the Income Tax Act pertaining to Assessment Year 2020-21 and raised the Demand of Rs. 18.37 crores. The Company has reason to believe that it has strong merit to oppose this order by way of filing the rectification application. While passing the order prior notice was not given, also the opportunity of being heard (Principle of Natural Justice) was not given. Moreover, the credit of Minimum Alternate tax of Rs. 15.12 crore was not taken into account while making the computation. Even the addition made of Rs. 1.41 crore is erroneous. Thus, the total demand raised of Rs. 18.37 crore is not correct.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed rectification Application on April 01, 2026.

operating_notes.text: Company operates in a single reportable segment, Polyester Films, per Ind AS 108.

Consolidated results include Garware Hi-Tech Films International Limited (100% subsidiary) and Global Hi-Tech Films Inc (100% step-down subsidiary), whose combined share of revenue was ₹764.56 Cr for FY26.
New SCF line adds ~1,200 LSF capacity with commercial production expected June 2027 (Q1FY28).
Domestic D2C network at 250+ Garware Application Studios and 6 Global Home Solutions, with a target of 50 GHS by end-FY27.
11 international Global Application Studios added (2 UAE, 9 USA).
Approved ₹191 Cr capex for a new SCF line adding 1,200 LSF/P.A. capacity with a 14-month execution timeline.
Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Garware Hi Tech Global Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, with an initial capital of AED 2,000,000.
Sun Control was about 55% of Q1FY27 revenue, PPF 20% and industrial products 25%, against 48-50%, 25% and 25% last year.
PPF old line runs near 100% utilisation and the new line about 60%; volumes lost to a ship delayed at Jebel Ali are expected to recover.
Management expects ₹50 Cr-plus net tariff refund in Q2FY27 after sharing part with US customers, with nothing booked in Q1FY27.
Q2FY27 working capital days 29 against 28 in FY26; cash and cash equivalents ₹933 Cr at 30 September 2026.
TPU extrusion platform investment of ₹118 Cr with Lubrizol technology, expected to add 150-200 bps to consolidated EBITDA margin.
Global Application Studios network at 14 (11 USA, 3 Middle East); Garware Home Solutions studios at 14, up from 9 in Q1FY27.
Value-added products contributed 86% of H1FY27 revenue.
TPU line expected to add 150-200 bps to consolidated EBITDA margin.
